description: This file defines the interface and classes for the str_format library in Abseil, providing type-safe string formatting functions similar to printf, including FormatSpec, ParsedFormat, and various formatting functions like StrFormat, PrintF, and FPrintF. It also includes classes for format specifications, sinks, and extension points for user-defined types.

classes.name: UntypedFormatSpec
classes.description: A type-erased class used for untyped formatting API, encapsulating a format string.

classes.name: FormatCountCapture
classes.description: A class to safely wrap `%n` conversions, capturing the number of characters written.

classes.name: FormatSpec
classes.description: A variadic class template defining the makeup of a format string, evaluated at compile-time.

classes.name: ParsedFormat
classes.description: A class template representing a pre-parsed format string with compile-time checked specifiers.

classes.name: FormatRawSink
classes.description: A type-erased wrapper around sink objects for formatted output.

classes.name: FormatSink
classes.description: A generic abstraction for writing formatted string data to various sinks.

classes.name: FormatConvertResult
classes.description: Indicates success or failure of a custom format conversion.

classes.name: FormatConversionChar
classes.description: Enumeration of format conversion characters (e.g., c, s, d, f, etc.).

classes.name: FormatConversionSpec
classes.description: Class representing modifications and flags for format conversions.

methods.name: StreamFormat
methods.description: Returns a streamable object for formatted output, similar to printf.

methods.name: PrintF
methods.description: Prints formatted output to stdout, similar to printf.

methods.name: FPrintF
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a FILE*, similar to fprintf.

methods.name: SNPrintF
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a buffer, similar to snprintf.

methods.name: StrFormat
methods.description: Returns a formatted string given a format string and arguments.

methods.name: StrAppendFormat
methods.description: Appends formatted output to an existing string.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Writes formatted data to an arbitrary sink object.

methods.name: FormatUntyped
methods.description: Most generic formatting function, with runtime format string and arguments.

methods.name: FormatStreamed
methods.description: Wraps a value for streaming with '%s' in format strings.

methods.name: FormatCountCapture
methods.description: Wraps `%n` conversions to safely capture character count.
